falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Online booking offers convenience; a soft chair offers comfort.

falseSynonyms.zh: 奢華；享受不等於一般的 comfort luxury = 奢華；享受 luxury 指昂貴、優質或非必要的享受。豪華可能帶來 comfort，但兩者不是同一概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A luxury hotel may be comfortable, but comfort does not require luxury.

falseSynonyms.zh: 愉快；樂趣不等於一般的 comfort pleasure = 愉快；樂趣 pleasure 是開心或享受的感覺；comfort 更常表示沒有不適、緊張或痛苦。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A funny film gives pleasure; reassurance gives comfort.

falseSynonyms.zh: 快樂不等於一般的 comfort happiness = 快樂 happiness 是較廣泛的正面情緒，不等於舒適、安心或安慰。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone can be comfortable without being especially happy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 支持；支援不等於一般的 comfort support = 支持；支援 support 可以帶來 comfort，但它是提供幫助的行動或資源，不是 comfort 這種感受本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Friends provide support, which may give emotional comfort.

falseSynonyms.zh: 舒適的不等於一般的 comfort comfortable = 舒適的 comfortable 是形容詞；comfort 在本課是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The chair is comfortable. The chair provides comfort.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人安慰的不等於一般的 comfort comforting = 令人安慰的 comforting 是形容詞，表示某事能帶來安慰；不是名詞 comfort 本身。
